challenges.name: SQL Injection Lab
challenges.description: Navigate to /Less-1/ and use SQL injection to find the admin user's password.

flag.query: ALTER TABLE users MODIFY password varchar(100); UPDATE users SET password='%s' WHERE username='admin'

challenges.name: OWASP Juice Shop
challenges.description: This application exposes a REST API. Find the endpoint that lets you read product details — one of them is hiding something it shouldn't be.

challenges.name: Source Hunt
challenges.description: There's something hidden on this web server. Start by reading the page carefully — the answer to where to look next is right in front of you.
command:
cat <<'EOF' > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html Source Hunt

Source Hunt

This is a simple learning challenge.

Start by reading the page source. If that does not help, check the usual web files.

EOF cat <<'EOF' > /usr/share/nginx/html/robots.txt User-agent: * Disallow: /flag.txt EOF nginx -g 'daemon off;'
